title: Waiting-Week Entries on Unemployment Benefit Claims
content:
A waiting-week entry on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record records the first otherwise-payable week of a benefit year as served and states the value the week would have paid, which is never paid later. The week valued is the latest week certified on the claim at the time the entry is made.

## When the value is fixed

The value of a waiting week is not fixed until the claim's dependency allowance no longer counts any dependent removed from the record.

This is a state of the claim record: the dependents counted in the claim's dependency allowance against the dependents now on record.

## Business effect

The claim's payment history gains one waiting-week entry, dated the day it is made, for that week with the value given; nothing is paid and the remaining balance is unchanged.

## Invocation

The function is `record_waiting_week_428070c9`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | The claim reference number of the claim, read from the claim lookup before the call | Identifier |
| `week_ending_date` | The Saturday ending the week served as the waiting week | YYYY-MM-DD, always a Saturday |
| `amount` | The value the week would have paid | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive |

## Return

A successful call returns `entry_id` (the reference number of the waiting-week entry), `claim_id`, `week_ending_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `amount` (USD). Receiving `entry_id` means the waiting week is recorded as served.

### Hypothetical input and return

A call for a claim with a remaining balance of 9000.00, a week ending on a Saturday and an amount of 264.00 returns that week ending date and an amount of 264.00; the remaining balance stays 9000.00.
